summary: Frontend-only verification of navbar restructure (Başvurularım moved under Başvuru Takip dropdown) and /vize-tipleri price-box row alignment. Desktop (1280/1440/1920), mobile (390) and price alignment across all 4 tabs verified. All checks passed with zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile sheet NavLinks in Navbar.jsx (lines 242-257 and 266-283) do not have data-testid attributes. Existing tests can rely on text selectors, but adding data-testid=`mobile-nav-link-<slug>` would improve future test robustness. Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navbar has: PRIMARY_LINKS=[/vize-tipleri]; TRACK_LINKS dropdown (data-testid=navbar-track-menu-trigger → menu=navbar-track-menu) with nav-link-takip and nav-link-hesabim; MENU_GROUPS dropdown (navbar-more-menu). Standalone top-level /hesabim link removed. Trigger receives active styling when path is /takip or /hesabim (trackActive). Mobile sheet renders [...PRIMARY_LINKS, ...TRACK_LINKS] under 'Başvuru' group. VisaTypeCard description has min-h-12 sm:min-h-[3rem] so price boxes align across the row (verified 0.00px delta on all 4 tabs at 1440px). Regression: /, /takip, /hesabim, /basvuru, /iletisim all render with zero console errors and footer intact.

test_findings.desktop_navbar: PASS - No standalone Başvurularım top-level link; trigger opens dropdown with both nav-link-takip and nav-link-hesabim; both navigate correctly; trigger shows active (text-primary) styling on /takip and /hesabim; no horizontal overflow at 1280/1440/1920.
test_findings.mobile_menu: PASS - Başvuru group lists Hizmet Bedelleri, Takip Kodu ile Sorgula, Başvurularım; clicking Başvurularım navigates to /hesabim and sheet closes; Takip Kodu ile Sorgula navigates to /takip.
test_findings.price_alignment_vize_tipleri: PASS - All 4 tabs (Tek Girişli, Çok Girişli, Çocuk Vizesi, Diğer Hizmetler) at 1440px show price box top delta = 0.00px between the two cards in the row.
test_findings.regression: PASS - /, /takip, /hesabim, /basvuru, /iletisim render with 0 console errors; footer present on all.
